task.title: Operational Centre Memo (MM06) required for the original decision

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Detection: Select the detection code that was used for the original decision.
Infraction: Select the infraction code that was used for the original decision.
Message: Select the OP message code that was used for the original decision.
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Misrepresentation
2 - Non misrepresentation
Remarks line 1: Type “ Undeliverable Notice of Debt. Rescind decision input on [DD-MM-YYYY] or MM06 dated [DD-MM-YYYY].”
Remarks line 2: Type “W/cs [XXXX] to [XXXX] are now outside of the reconsideration period.”

Remarks line 3: Type “Re-input the OP for remaining weeks at current date.” If there is also a penalty, provide the following information:
P: penalty percentage, including mitigating circumstances
LMR: 1st, 2nd or 3rd level of misrepresentation (for the penalty percentage)
MPA: maximum penalty amount
LVA: legal validation amount
VLN: violation information (V-1-1 warning letter issued or 0 penalty imposed)
Integrity case number
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the new decision letters to replace the decision letters whose status was changed to undeliverable.
Determine if a D48 or a MA48 is imposed:

ul.li: If a D48 is not imposed, complete the WI.
If a D48 or a MA48 is imposed go to Determining if inputs are required for a suspension of benefits . Determining if inputs are required for a suspension of benefits
